Unicode 16.0.0 data used by shaping, bidi and line breaking (Unicode License v3: UNICODE-LICENSE.txt).
  BidiTest.txt.gz, BidiCharacterTest.txt.gz - official UBA conformance files, gzip-compressed unmodified (run by BidiConformanceTests).
  generate_unicode_tables.py - downloads the pinned (SHA-256) UCD files and writes src/PortableDocument.Content/Shaping/UnicodeTables.cs.
